push.title: D 2-2 vs The Chozen | You: 8.3
push.body:
Solid shift, PhogsToffees. An 8.3 clears the bar for a forward, and solid is the soil good things grow in.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at The Chozen's goal. You got into shooting spots again and again.
+ 1 key pass. Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ Man of the Match, your 28th for us. Man of the Match: the highest compliment the game gives out.
+ Tackles attempted 9, up from your usual 5. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ You & Soup_Kitchen22 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.

THE BAD
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Homework: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
- Won 1 of 9 tackles. Old coach's advice: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- shot selection hit you and BellyTb1 both. Partner drill: cut it back to each other.
- Giveaways 17, up from your usual 14. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.

Before next match: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: A goal is just a pass to the net.

Let the lesson stick, let the frustration go. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
BellyTb1, that 8.0 was a sturdy day's work. Proud of you.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ That link with PhogsToffees was smoother than a Cadillac on new pavement.
+ Completed passes 30, up from your usual 20. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. Proof you've got another gear.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (8.0 vs their best 7.7). Gold star, no notes.

THE BAD
- 0 of 2 shots on target. Next rep: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. You're closer than you think.
- Both you and PhogsToffees dipped on shot selection. Lean on each other: cut it back to each other.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. Here's the trick: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- Worst misplaced passes of your 3 matches this session (8). Not who you are, but it was who showed up.

Skills corner: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

Small fixes, big changes. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
Soup_Kitchen22, a 6.6 against The Chozen. You were close to a good one. Let's find the missing piece.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against The Chozen. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is gold. Don't let it rust.
+ 6.6: your best match performance of the season. Remember how that felt.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (4). That's the reliable kind of good.
+ 1 key pass counted for +0.1. That's the hidden value in your game.

THE BAD
- Lowest match rating on the team: 6.6 (best was PhogsToffees's 8.3). Let's turn that around by next session.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 1). Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was PhogsToffees's 4). Coach's tip: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.
- Worst missed tackles of your 3 matches this session (3). Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.

THE UGLY
! 64% passing (7 of 11). That one hurt the team, and the team deserves better. Real talk: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.

Practice this: With your back to goal, shield it and set it back to the runner facing play. Turning into traffic is a coin flip.

Hey Soup_Kitchen22, hold onto this one: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

One step at a time, partner. - Coach Lasso
